data_fields.name: reaper_period
data_fields.donor_constant: 20 ticks per pass (once a second at 20 ticks per second)

best_idea: Give each zone a fixed pool of pre-built claim slots, own a slot by a durable party or character key, and free a slot only after its footprint has been empty for a timeout that is longer when the boss is dead.
decision_why: Row 23 needs exactly this despawn-on-empty with a grace timer; the footprint and timeouts become zone data, the donor's fixed footprint literal and global timeouts are fixed, and the owner key is the server character id so a relog rejoins the same claim.
acceptance: A server test asserts the claim is still held at 299 s empty and freed at 300 s, is held to 900 s when the boss is dead, a relogged member rejoins the same claim, and a 25th concurrent party gets a busy result.
